title: Replay the 84-ADD R439 multi-column handoffs through native engines
body:
PR2440 leaves native replay open for its exact 84-ADD multi-column scatter. This contribution executes that stream through the unchanged legality and 5/9/11-stage C++ column engines, with complete RAW6 and frame/state metadata bindings. The 84construction and 11,057 total ADDs remain Sagar Thakrar's result; no new circuit, optimum or kappa is claimed.

Both the 94split baseline and 84candidate pass. The candidate covers 883/1,327/1,549 formal columns, three nontrivial COPY windows and one private slot. All 96 omitted-bridge controls reject across the two words. Three new handoff controls reject overlapping copies, an ERASE naming the old owner and a stale tap after slot reuse. The stale tap preserves the exact native legality receipt but all three column engines reject its changed endpoint.

The original PR2440 CLI and full receipt run before native staging. Its six consumed files are retained with exact head/blob/SHA256 pins. Registered Python 3.12 replay, Git-free export, read-only verification, three source/typed-receipt corruptions and final native receipt comparison pass. Actual compilation used GCC 16.2.0 and Boost 1.90.0 on Windows. A separate terminate-diagnostic translation unit exposes existing uncaught legality exceptions; no native checker predicate or successful path is changed.

Scope remains finite native geometry/columns. Empty owner/selection fixtures do not perform a bank or hosted audit. Physical scratch/routing, whole-call hosting, all-size/compiler/common-label realization, precision/tape beyond inherited scalar envelopes, analytic transfer and replacement-interface adoption remain external. Native phase labels are authenticated by exact stream binding, not by the engines. No selected cold replay, Lean proof or hosted CI pass is claimed.

Credit: Sagar Thakrar PR2440/2115/1062; Ross Richardson PR2407/2437; starship-s PR2421; Gareth Davidson PR2373; Sricharan Vagvala PR2356; Charles Bethin PR2279 and the preserved supplier/checker/exporter lineage. New work is Apache-2.0, prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review.

The task picker drew bit-helper-contract, nonce 95e2790a30bd5a4a004af834d573d6ae. TASK.json records the change from covered H2/K semantics to this explicit native handoff. Base is current canonical main 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4. PR2421 covers the prior 88 stream; PR2448 explicitly excludes this 2440 stream.

Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2440#issuecomment-6195286606

Final live overlap: 778 open PRs and 1239 Discussion records, both completely paginated. Fetch timestamps: 2026-10-15T15:19:19.477835+00:00 and 2026-10-15T15:22:22.047084+00:00. No matching native audit found; coverage limitations remain explicit.
